major_events: In Chapter 793 (第793章 路尽见无始), Ye Fan, Duan De, and Lao Xiazi venture deep into the stone halls of Zishan (Purple Mountain) and find the colossal Wushi Bell (无始钟) concealed within the rock wall.
In Chapter 794, the group reaches the Wushi Dao Platform and discovers Gu Tianshu (古天舒), the ancient human saint who followed Wushi Great Emperor, alive and meditating in Zishan.
In Chapter 799 (第799章 无始钟连响三月), the Wushi Bell rings continuously for three months, creating a massive deterrent that halts the aggressive advance of the Taigu ancient clans.

In Chapter 805, the Northern Domain descends into absolute chaos, forcing the Douzhan Shengfo (Fighting Victory Buddha) to issue a supreme decree, initiating the convocation of the Ten Thousand Races Conference at Yaochi.
In Chapter 811 (第811章 封神慑万族), the human race deploys the Fengshen Bang (封神榜), an imperial weapon created by Wushi Great Emperor, to suppress and deter the ancient clans across the Northern Domain.
In Chapter 813, the Shencan Princess (神蚕公主) is successfully revived from a giant source block by Ye Fan and the Yaochi sect, shifting the power balance between humans and ancient races.

In Chapter 821 (第821章 祖王齐至神曲现) and Chapter 822, the Yaochi Conference is disrupted by the arrival of multiple Taigu Ancestral Kings, prompting the appearance of Jiang Taixu (the White-clad God King) who plays the 'God's Prelude' (神之曲) to declare his return.
In Chapters 823-825, Jiang Taixu demonstrates his second-life revitalization, defeating multiple Taigu Ancestral Kings in single combat to defend the human race's dignity.

In Chapter 829 (第829章 大圣和谈), the Taigu Great Sages negotiate, and the Wushi Great Emperor's decree ('天下无圣' - No Sages in the World) is declared, forcing all Sage-level cultivators to leave the active battlefields.
In Chapters 835-840, Ye Fan joins forces with the survivor Qi Luo to rebuild the legendary assassin dynasty 'Heavenly Court' (天庭), setting up their base in the secret 'Village of Heaven' (天之村).

In Chapter 847 (第847章 冥土) and Chapters 848-850, Ye Fan and his allies descend into the ancient Nether Soil (冥土/太古的炼狱), where they encounter the mutated fifth Yuantian Master who has turned into a red-haired monster due to the Saint Body curse.

In Chapter 856 (第856章 背对众生) and Chapters 860-865, Ye Fan challenges Yuan Gu (descendant of the Primordial Emperor / Yuan Huang) and defeats him in the Yuanxu Realm using Wushi Great Emperor's secret arts, shocking the ancient races.
In Chapters 874-877, the Fighting Victory Buddha clashes with ancient kings at the Taichu Ancient Mine (太初古矿) and other restricted zones, establishing a mutual non-aggression truce.
In Chapters 883-885, Ye Fan fakes his own death ('坑杀自己') to lure out his enemies, successfully wiping out a large host of ancient and human adversaries in the Tianduan Mountains.
In Chapter 900 (第900章 斩道), Ye Fan undergoes the dangerous 'Zhandao' (Path-Cutting) tribulation, successfully executing a contrarian breakthrough (逆行斩道) to reach the King realm.
In Chapters 909-918, a major conflict erupts in the Middle Earth Ancestral Temple (中州祖庙) over the nine-heaven divine coffin (九龙拉棺). Ye Fan defeats Hua Yunfei, who tragically dies as the '谪仙'.
In Chapter 926 (第926章 离开这个世界), Ye Fan activates the five-colored altar at the Ancestral Temple to leave the Big Dipper world, while Li Xiaoman falls into the dark abyss.
In Chapter 935 (第935章 降临地球), Ye Fan and his party cross the cosmos and land on Earth, finding his home planet highly altered and his parents deceased.
In Chapters 946-948, Ye Fan travels to Lingshan, discovering the dried-up Buddhist holy land and meeting the remnants/projections of Shakyamuni.
In Chapters 967-972, Ye Fan explores the 99 Dragon Mountains (九十九龙山) on Earth, learning how the Yuhua Divine Dynasty drained Earth's spiritual veins to refine the成仙鼎 (Immortal Cauldron).
In Chapter 997 (第997章 天庭临尘世), Ye Fan defeats the Pope in the Vatican, retrieves several fragments of the成仙图 (Immortal Map), and establishes the Earth branch of the Heavenly Court.
character_state_transitions: Ye Fan (叶凡): Transitions from a Beidou Half-Sage cultivator to the King Realm in Chapter 900 after surviving the unique 'contrarian path-cutting' (逆行斩道) tribulation.
Ye Fan (叶凡): Transitions geographically from Beidou (the Big Dipper world) in Chapter 926 to Earth in Chapter 935 via the five-colored altar.
Jiang Taixu (姜太虚 - White-clad God King): Transitions from a near-death, desiccated state to a rejuvenated second life (活到第二世) in Chapter 823, restoring his battle power.
Shencan Princess (神蚕公主): Transitions from a frozen, lifeless state inside a source stone (源石) to a revived, active Saint-level protector of the human race in Chapter 813.
Yuan Gu (元古): Transitions from the living, arrogant heir of the Primordial Emperor (元皇) to deceased after being defeated by Ye Fan in Chapter 865.
Hua Yunfei (华云飞): Transitions from an active, tragic practitioner of the Heaven-Swallowing Demon Art to deceased (谪仙殒) in Chapter 918 after his final duel with Ye Fan.
Li Xiaoman (李小曼): Transitions from an active antagonist influenced by Crocodile Ancestor to missing/fallen in the dark abyss of Beidou in Chapter 925/926.
Crocodile Ancestor (鳄祖): Transitions from an escaped ancient demon on Yinghuo to deceased in Chapter 932 after being hunted down by Ye Fan's party.
Ge Hong (葛洪): Revealed to have transitioned from an ancient human alchemist on Earth to a Yin Spirit (阴神) / undead state due to the planet's spiritual decline.
The Pope (教皇): Transitions from the supreme leader of the Western cultivation church to deceased in Chapter 997 after losing to Ye Fan at the Vatican.
long_form_mechanisms: Zhandao (斩道 - Cutting the Path): A major breakthrough mechanism in Beidou's cultivation system where a cultivator must sever an obsession or align with the heavens. Ye Fan achieves '逆行斩道', refusing to cut his humanity and instead cutting the constraints of heaven.

Fengshen Bang (封神榜 - Investiture of the Gods): An imperial weapon created by Wushi Great Emperor that utilizes Beidou's geological veins and mountain veins to project his supreme suppressive will over Sages and Ancestral Kings.

Yuantian Curse (源天师晚年不详): A supernatural backlash mechanism affecting Yuantian Masters. Due to their manipulation of geological structures and source energy, they grow red hair and turn into mindless monsters in their late years.

99 Dragon Mountains (九十九龙山): A massive planetary-scale formation designed to extract the spiritual essence and veins of a planet (like Earth) to nurture and repair the damaged '成仙鼎' (Immortal Cauldron).

Yin Spirit Transformation (阴神转化): A survival mechanism for ancient Earth cultivators in a declining spiritual environment. Instead of dying, they transform into Yin Spirits to preserve their consciousness in a semi-undead state inside ancient tombs.

Five-Colored Altar Space Teleportation (五色祭坛空间传送): An ancient cosmic transport network that requires massive source energy or special keys (like the '彼岸钥匙') to open space portals connecting different star systems.
Yuanxu Realm (元墟界): An isolated battlefield space created by ancient sages to contain the destructive energy of Saint-level and King-level battles, preventing collateral damage to the main world.
God's Prelude (神之曲): A domain-based sonic technique used by Jiang Taixu that harmonizes with the natural Dao to dissolve an opponent's physical body and laws into the universe's basic elements.
continuity_observations: The curse of the Yuantian Master is shown to be connected with the general Saint Body curse ('圣体不祥'), demonstrating a consistent lore linkage regarding cosmic backlashes in Chapters 847-850.
Upon landing on Earth in Chapter 935, Ye Fan notes that Earth feels much larger and more grand than its physical dimensions, setting up the existence of folded dimensions like Kunlun.
The historical migration of Earth's sages (Laozi, Shakyamuni) to Beidou is consistently reinforced, such as the Fighting Victory Buddha referencing Shakyamuni's teachings in Chapter 878.
The collection of the nine '成仙图' (Immortal Map fragments) is tracked continuously, with Ye Fan acquiring the sixth and seventh fragments from the Vatican in Chapter 997.
The Wushi Bell's ability to ring for three months without active manual control (Chapter 799) is explained by its location on the Wushi Dao Platform, drawing on natural geological veins.
Hua Yunfei's tragic role as a puppet host for the Heaven-Swallowing Demon Art is resolved in Chapter 918, explaining his prior ambiguous actions and deep resentment of his own fate.
The Crocodile Ancestor, who escaped the seal under the Great Leiyin Temple on Yinghuo in the novel's first chapter, is finally killed by Ye Fan in Chapter 932, completing a massive narrative loop.
The Fengshen Bang is used as a strategic deterrent at Yaochi, matching its established role as the Wushi Great Emperor's primary suppressive tool on Beidou.
style_observations: Frequent use of hyperbolic phrases (e.g., '余波震动九天', '血流成河') to emphasize the immense scale and destructive power of high-level cultivation battles.
Repetitive 'back-and-forth' pacing in battle scenes where an enemy displays an ancient technique, onlookers explain its history, and the protagonist counters it to their shock.
A distinct stylistic shift in tone from high-fantasy cultivation jargon to modern urban-fantasy when Ye Fan returns to Earth (referencing cities, cars, and auction houses).
A recurring visual motif focusing on the 'back' of supreme figures (especially Wushi Great Emperor's '背对众生') to establish a theme of lonely grandeur and absolute power.
Direct author interjections breaking the fourth wall (e.g., Chen Dong asking readers for monthly votes at the end of Chapter 821 in Line 2619).
Integration of real Chinese historical and mythological figures (Rongcheng Shi, Ge Hong, Nüwa) into the cosmic fantasy framework, grounding the story in familiar cultural myths.

The file is extremely clean with no OCR scan brackets (e.g. '【', '】', '〔', '〕') or scan artifacts, indicating a direct digital conversion from the online serial publication rather than a physical book scan.

originality_risks: The 'Arrogant Young Master' archetype: Taigu heirs (like Yuan Gu) consistently display extreme arrogance, treat humans as food/inferior, and underestimate the protagonist, which is a very standard xianxia trope.

Western Cultivation Clichés: Western religious and mythological factions (the Vatican, knights, Pope) are depicted as greedy and hypocritical, relying on Western artifacts that are easily overcome by Eastern cultivation.
The Cursed Bloodline trope: The Saint Body curse ('圣体晚年不详') is a typical fantasy element where the protagonist's unique power has a fatal flaw they must overcome through willpower.
Repetitive Fake Death device: Ye Fan's use of a fake death ('坑杀自己') to draw out and slaughter multiple factions of enemies is a recurring plot device that can feel repetitive across different arcs.
